purpose: Additive interval/provenance sidecar for the 2026-09-25..27 ledger rows. The ledger scalars are unchanged; consumers that score or classify should use time_window_local and depth_lo/hi_in, and treat surrogate/window times and range midpoints as such.

bases.stated: endpoints in the owner's own words
bases.stated_landmarks: endpoints from named landmarks the owner cited
bases.adjacent_entries: untimed line bounded by the timed lines around it
bases.unquantified: approximate/qualitative with no defensible numeric width; lo/hi or window are null

scoring_rule: Score only against bounds whose basis is stated, stated_landmarks or adjacent_entries. Unquantified rows are point/nominal values with unknown width; never invent a width for them.
landmark_bounds_source: data/observation_bounds.jsonl (append-only, row-hash keyed; bands from model/elevations.md and assets/map_points.csv; basis stated_landmarks)
